films.title: Kevin Hart: Laugh at My Pain
films.overview: Experience the show that quickly became a national phenomenon. Get an up-close and personal look at Kevin back in Philly where he began his journey to become one of the funniest comedians of all time.

films.title: Kevin Hart: Let Me Explain
films.overview: Captures the laughter, energy and mayhem from Hart's 2012 "Let Me Explain" concert tour, which spanned 10 countries and 80 cities, and generated over $32 million in ticket sales.

films.title: Kevin Hart: What Now?
films.overview: Comedian Kevin Hart performs in front of a crowd of 50,000 people at Philadelphia's outdoor venue, Lincoln Financial Field.

films.title: Kevin Hart: Irresponsible
films.overview: Stand-up comedian Kevin Hart talks about his family, travel and a year full of reckless behavior in front of a live sold-out crowd in London.

films.title: Holiday Rush
films.overview: After his sudden firing, a popular radio DJ moves in with his aunt, bringing along his four spoiled children, and a plan to return to the airwaves.

films.title: 2 Minutes of Fame
films.overview: An up-and-coming stand-up comic moves to L.A. to pursue a film career after video clips of his act make him an online sensation.

films.title: Kevin Hart: Zero F**ks Given
films.overview: Kevin Hart serves up laughs and brick oven pizza from the comfort of his home, and dishes on male group chats, sex after 40 and life with COVID-19.
